title: 100 Square-Root Fractions, No Calculator | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
What is the whole-number part of 1/√1 + 1/√2 + … + 1/√100? Vantee shows how to trap the sum between a floor and a ceiling by growing squares, then gives a quick algebra version for test day. You will see why 19 and 20 are tempting traps, and get a 10,000-term challenge to try yourself.
